items.caption:
Swallowed gum stays in you for seven years, right? 🤔 Nope — it's out in a few days. Your body can't digest gum, but it keeps it moving. 🦜🐶

Animated cartoon. Voices are synthetic (AI text-to-speech).

Swallow a watermelon seed and a watermelon grows in your tummy? 🍉😄 Nope, nothing happens — no sunlight or soil inside you, so a seed can't sprout. 🦜🐶

Animated cartoon. Voices are synthetic (AI text-to-speech).

The five-second rule keeps dropped food clean? ⏱️ Sorry — germs jump on the instant it lands. Bacteria stick on contact, and a damp snack picks up even more. 🦜🐶

Animated cartoon. Voices are synthetic (AI text-to-speech).

Cracking your knuckles gives you arthritis? 😬 Nope — it's just tiny gas bubbles popping. One doctor cracked one hand for 60 years and found no difference. 🦜🐶

Animated cartoon. Voices are synthetic (AI text-to-speech).

Eat tons of carrots and you'll see in the dark? 🥕 Sorry — healthy eyes, but no night vision. That idea was a World War Two story made up to hide radar. 🦜🐶

Animated cartoon. Voices are synthetic (AI text-to-speech).

Does the color red make a bull angry? 🐂 Nope — bulls are red-green colorblind. They charge the moving cape, not the color. 🦜🐶

Animated cartoon. Voices are synthetic (AI text-to-speech).

Goldfish forget everything in three seconds? 🐠 Nope — they remember for months. They learn feeding times, colors, and can even do little tricks. 🦜🐶

Animated cartoon. Voices are synthetic (AI text-to-speech).

Do we really only use 10% of our brains? 🧠 Nope — you use nearly all of it, just not all at once. Every part has a job, even at rest. 🦜🐶

Animated cartoon. Voices are synthetic (AI text-to-speech).

#didyouknow #mythbusting #funfacts #learnontiktok #whatif #curiousfacts #science

Does shaving grow hair back thicker and darker? 🪒 Nope — it grows back exactly the same. A razor only cuts the surface, not the root. 🦜🐶

Animated cartoon. Voices are synthetic (AI text-to-speech).

#didyouknow #mythbusting #funfacts #learnontiktok #whatif #curiousfacts #science

Do you lose most of your body heat through your head? 🧢 Nope — only about a tenth. Heat leaves any bare skin; the head's just usually uncovered. 🦜🐶

Animated cartoon. Voices are synthetic (AI text-to-speech).

Does sugar make kids hyper? 🍬 Nope — careful studies show no real change. It's the exciting party, plus grown-ups expecting a 'sugar rush'. 🦜🐶

Animated cartoon. Voices are synthetic (AI text-to-speech).

Is your blood blue inside you until air hits it? 🩸 Nope — it's always red. Your skin just scatters light, so veins look blue. 🦜🐶

Animated cartoon. Voices are synthetic (AI text-to-speech).

Can you tickle yourself? 🪶 Nope — your brain predicts your own touch and cancels the tickle. You need a surprise (a friend 😄). 🦜🐶

Does reading in dim light wreck your eyes? 🔦📖 Nope — it just tires them. They work harder in the dark, but a rest fixes it. No lasting damage. 🦜🐶

Animated cartoon. Voices are synthetic (AI text-to-speech).

Are bats blind? 🦇 Nope — 'blind as a bat' is a myth. Bats see just fine, and many also 'see' with sound (echolocation). 🦜🐶

Do ostriches bury their heads in the sand to hide? 🦩 Nope — they dip their heads to turn eggs in a ground nest. From afar it just looks buried. 🦜🐶

Do dogs see only black and white? 🐶 Nope — they see blues and yellows, just not reds and greens. Two colour sensors instead of three. 🦜🐶

Are elephants scared of mice? 🐘🐭 Not really — they startle at sudden movement, not at mice themselves. It's the surprise, not the squeak. 🦜🐶
